en: This is a black-and-white collage-style postcard showing seven different buildings in the city of Blaj, each photographed separately, most likely educational institutions given the architectural styles and captions visible. The title 'Blaj' is prominently featured at the top, and at the bottom, it reads 'IV. Școlile secundare,' indicating a focus on secondary schools. All buildings appear to be classical or early 20th-century European architecture.
